name: Daniel Kwabla Avudzivi
tagline: Oil and gas analyst supporting downstream businesses with research-backed recommendations and practical insights.
aboutIntro: Here you’ll find what I do and how I can support your energy business.
mission: My mission is to support Ghana’s energy sector with research, quality and clear communication.

roles.label: Analyst
roles.description: I support oil and gas business operations with research-backed recommendations, developing market research, industry reports and policy analyses for downstream petroleum companies.

roles.label: Quality & Safety
roles.description: I help service companies satisfy their clients by putting quality management systems in place and reducing operational downtime, with skills in process safety and accident investigation.

roles.label: Communicator
roles.description: I help industry professionals strengthen their media presence through articles and social media, and serve as Communications Officer for SPE Africa Region.

roles.label: SPE Leader
roles.description: I chair the Membership Committee of SPE Ghana Section, leading growth, engagement and retention for Ghana’s energy professionals.

projectsIntro: These are the initiatives I’ve led, contributed to, or supported across Ghana’s energy sector.
careerIntro: The journey to becoming who I am today wasn’t easy, and I look back on every step with love. Below are my key roles.
blogIntro: Here you can read my news, business insights, and other experiences.
blogQuote: It’s important to share knowledge with those who have chosen the same path as you.

seo.title: Daniel Kwabla Avudzivi | Oil & Gas Analyst, Accra
seo.description: Daniel Kwabla Avudzivi is an oil and gas analyst in Accra, Ghana: downstream research, quality and safety, and energy communications. Chairperson of the SPE Ghana Membership Committee.
